findings.title: Tax page's year selector defaults to a year with no activity instead of the ledger's actual year
findings.observed: After session 1's two fills (XLE, SPY bought 2026-07-27; account funded 2026-07-24), I opened /tax. The year selector loaded already on 2026, not 2025, and read: 'Nothing was disposed of in 2026. The ledger holds 3 transactions dated in this tax year -- see Activity -- but no lot was sold, so there is no gain or loss to report and no Form 8949 to file for it.' Every transaction I have is correctly attributed to the year shown by default.
findings.expected: The default year should resolve from the ledger's most recent transaction, not a hardcoded currentYear-1, exactly what shipped.
findings.why_it_matters: A wrong default year previously read as a failed import to three independent personas across runs 3-5. Getting the right year on first paint is what stops that misdiagnosis before it starts.
repro: Fund and trade a fresh ledger (only 2026 activity)
Read the year selector's initial value without touching it
